title: Learn by making.
text:
Creation Studios
      UMN Libraries · Creation Hubs
    
  
  



  
    About Creation Studios
    
    Creation Studios is a free, open program from University of Minnesota Libraries Creation Hubs. It runs three studios — Maker, Media, and Dev — each a line of hands-on tracks. Hop on anywhere, open a module's deck, and leave with something you made.
  

  
    
      
      
        What it is
        A free, slide-based curriculum across three studios — maker (3D printing, sewing, CAD, laser and vinyl cutting), media (capture, production, publishing), and dev (launch, code, ship). Every module is a self-contained deck you can follow at your own pace, in the Creation Hubs or anywhere you have a browser.
      
    

    
      
      
        How the studios work
        Each studio is a page of tracks, and each track is a line of hands-on stops — ending in Create, where you build your own original project. Modules open as decks land; dashed cards are coming soon.
        
          Maker
          Media
          Dev
        
      
    

    
      
      
        Open & remixable
        Everything here is licensed CC BY 4.0 and built in the open with Quarto and RevealJS. Educators and makers are welcome to reuse, adapt, and remix the decks — see CONTRIBUTING.md if you'd like to help build the next stop.
      
    

    
      
      
        Who makes it
        Creation Studios is made by University of Minnesota Libraries — Engagement, Outreach & Community Partnerships, the team behind the Creation Hubs. Stop by a hub, or start with any deck on the home page.

text:
Try the new layout →


  
  Select a module below to open its deck




  Design
  

    
      Intro to CAD
      
        01
        Toy Brick Character
        Parametric design in Autodesk Fusion — sketch, dimension, extrude, fit tolerances, and stud patterns.
      
      Open module
    

    
      Intro to Vector Design
      
        02
        Marble Maze
        Foundations of vector design tools and concepts.
      
      Open module
    

    
      Intro to Digital Pattern Making
      
        03
        Pajama Pants
        Draft and refine digital sewing patterns — from measurements to a sewable pajama pant block.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to ECAD
      
        04
        Synthesizer
        Principles of electronic circuit design — layout, simulation, and a buildable pocket synthesizer.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to Microcontrollers
      
        05
        Pinball Machine
        Embedded programming fundamentals — sensors, loops, and game logic in a pinball machine project.
      
      Open module
    

  

  Make
  

    
      Intro to Sewing
      
        01
        Drawstring Bag
        Thread a machine, prep fabric, sew a seam, and finish a drawstring bag from start to end.
      
      Open module
    

    
      Intro to 3D Printing
      
        02
        Benchy
        FDM 3D printing from model to finished print — slicer settings, supports, and a full benchy run.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to Machine Embroidery
      
        03
        Embroidered Patch
        Machine embroidery fundamentals — digitizing, stabilizing, and finishing a felt patch.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to Vacuum Forming
      
        04
        Chocolate Bar Mold
        Shape thermoplastics with heat and vacuum — design and form a chocolate bar mold.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to CNC Milling
      
        05
        PCB
        Subtractive manufacturing on the CNC mill — fixtures, tool paths, and a finished circuit board.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to Laser Cutting
      
        06
        Keychain
        Vector cutting and scoring on the laser — material prep, settings, and a polished keychain.
      
      Coming soon
    

    
      Intro to Vinyl Cutting
      
        07
        Sticker
        Weed and transfer cut vinyl — from digital artwork to a finished sticker.
      
      Coming soon
